title: 9 Best Clipping Agencies for Livestreamers to Go Viral in 2026
summary: Overlap, listed first as software-run managed clipping campaigns on accounts you own, compared with nine clipping agencies for livestreamers by model, account ownership, pricing model, who edits, approval control, and reporting.
body_markdown:
Most livestreamers are sitting on a goldmine they never touch. Every stream contains reaction moments, highlight plays, hot takes, and genuine laugh-out-loud exchanges that would stop a scroll cold on TikTok or Reels. The problem is that turning a three-hour VOD into a week's worth of short-form content takes time that most streamers simply do not have.


That is where clipping campaigns come in. They find the best moments, edit them for short-form formats, and push them across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and X. For streamers trying to grow beyond their core platform, this kind of distribution can be the difference between staying flat and breaking through to a new audience entirely.


**The challenge:** a typical clipping agency distributes through accounts in its network. The agency keeps the handles, followers, audience relationships, and monetization upside, while the streamer rents the reach for the length of the campaign. That can work for a short burst, but it does not leave you with a channel that keeps compounding after the campaign ends.


That is why[Overlap](https://overlap.ai/brands/streamers) , which publishes this guide, is listed first. It is not a traditional clipping agency: it runs software-run managed clipping campaigns on accounts the streamer owns, with an agent doing the cutting, captioning, and posting under rules you set. Campaigns are billed at a CPM between $0.50 and $2.50 on delivered views, agreed per campaign, up to a monthly ceiling, with no production fees. You keep the handles, followers, posts, performance data, and any creator payouts or revenue share those accounts qualify to earn.


This guide starts with Overlap’s owned model, then breaks down nine traditional clipping agencies for livestreamers in 2026 and who each option fits best.


## How this comparison was evaluated


**Disclosure:** This article is published by Overlap and lists Overlap's own campaign offer first. The order after Overlap is for navigation, not a ranking, and nothing here is a controlled performance test.


**Source review:** September 17, 2026. Each agency entry summarizes that provider's public pages as linked. Figures attributed to an agency are the agency's own statements and are not verified here. Overlap's entry is filled from its own published pages, linked beside it. We did not run test campaigns with these providers.


### What Livestreamers Should Look for in a Clipping Agency


The evaluation criteria for a streamer are different from a podcaster or brand. Before choosing, ask:


- **VOD compatibility:** Can they work directly from Twitch, YouTube, or Kick VODs, or do you need to export and deliver files manually?
- **Clip volume per stream:** How many clips do they produce per session? One or two is not enough to build momentum.
- **Platform coverage:** Do they distribute to TikTok, Reels, and Shorts simultaneously, or just one platform?
- **Turnaround speed:** Streaming moments are time-sensitive. A clip from last Tuesday's stream has a shorter shelf life than a podcast episode.
- **Editorial vs. network model:** Hand-edited clips with intentional hooks perform differently than bulk-exported community clips. Know which you are getting.


## 1. Overlap: Software-Run Managed Clipping Campaigns, Not a Traditional Agency


**Best for: Streamers who want clipping at scale while keeping their accounts, followers, content library, performance data, and monetization upside**


Overlap is an AI video clipping platform. Teams run it themselves, or Overlap's team runs managed clipping campaigns for them on accounts the customer owns, priced per delivered view.[Overlap](https://overlap.ai/brands/streamers) publishes this guide, and its campaign offer is a different kind of provider from the nine agencies below. It is an AI-fulfilled clipping campaign platform: the campaign covers clip selection, editing, formatting, approval workflows, publishing, and reporting, and it runs on accounts the streamer owns. An agent works through your VODs, applies your captions and brand rules, holds anything off-brief for review, and publishes to your connected accounts.


For a streamer, account ownership is the biggest difference. Clips can publish to your main channels or to dedicated clip handles, and either way the logins, followers, published library, and first-party analytics stay with you during and after the campaign. Where an account qualifies for a platform's creator payouts or revenue share, that revenue is yours. When a campaign ends the posts are not taken down and the accounts are never repurposed for another advertiser.


**Pricing model:** an agreed CPM on delivered views, between $0.50 and $2.50, up to a monthly ceiling you set. The rate is agreed per campaign. There are no production fees and no minimum deliverables; nothing is charged for reach that did not land. Views are read from the platforms' own analytics on your accounts, so you can check them in the same dashboards.


**Platforms:** TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Threads, Snapchat, and Bluesky.


**Published results:** Overlap's[Playback case study](https://overlap.ai/case-studies/playback-case-study) reports 170+ hours of live streams repurposed into 1.5M views in 60 days, and the[iHeartMedia case study](https://overlap.ai/case-studies/how-iheart-generated-151-million-views-in-60-days-without-hiring-a-single-editor) reports 600M views and 100K clips without hiring an editor. These describe individual outcomes on the agent platform the campaign offer runs on; they are not a benchmark for a new campaign.


**Trade-off:** if you want a burst through a third-party page network, an editor's bespoke creative work, or a specific creator's existing audience, one of the agencies below may fit better.


### How the Model Works


1. **Connect your content and accounts:** Choose the VOD sources and the social accounts the campaign should use.
2. **Set the creative rules:** Define the moments, clip length, captions, branding, exclusions, and who approves what before it posts.
3. **Set the budget ceiling and CPM:** Fulfillment, publishing, and reporting run from there, with spend tied to delivered views.


**Sources reviewed September 17, 2026:**[Overlap for streamers](https://overlap.ai/brands/streamers) ,[brand campaign scope and pricing](https://overlap.ai/brands) ,[Overlap facts](https://overlap.ai/overlap-facts) ,[campaign overview and CPM calculator](https://overlap.ai/clipping-campaigns) .


## 2. Clip Central


**Best for: Brands, streamers, and creators who want a faceless-page distribution network with enterprise-grade reach**


[Clip Central](https://clipcentral.co/) is one of the most infrastructure-heavy options on this list. They describe themselves as "the talent agency for the internet's biggest faceless pages," and that framing tells you a lot about their model: instead of posting clips from your own account, they push your content through a managed network of high-performing clipping pages across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and X.


Their numbers are significant. Clip Central reports 3.5 billion monthly views across their network and 300M+ followers reached. Their client roster includes Rumble, UFC, Coinbase, Universal, NFL, Verizon, and Warner Bros, which signals they operate at a scale most clipping agencies simply cannot match.


### How Their Model Works


Clip Central offers four distinct service lines:


- **Clip Distribution:** Content pushed through their existing network of high-performing clipping pages
- **White Label Distribution:** Their infrastructure, branded to you
- **Internal Creative Agency:** In-house team that edits long-form content into short-form clips
- **Account Creation (Mass Distribution):** They create accounts specifically around your brand (e.g., yourstream.clips) and post exclusively your content


Their pricing is CPM-based, meaning you pay per 1,000 impressions rather than a flat retainer. They cite a $0.001 to $0.004 CPV, which they compare favorably to Meta Ads ($0.01 to $0.03 CPV) and TikTok Ads ($0.005 to $0.02 CPV).


### Who It Is Best For


Clip Central is best suited for streamers who already have compelling content and want maximum distribution reach without managing a team. The faceless-page model is particularly powerful for gaming, entertainment, and reaction-style streams where the clip itself does the work, regardless of whether it is attached to a named account.


> **Key consideration:** Clip Central is positioned more as a brand distribution platform than a pure streamer service. If you are an individual creator who wants personal brand growth tied to your own channel, the white-label or account creation services are the more relevant options.


## 3. Clipping Culture


**Best for: Streamers and creators who want a high-volume, performance-driven campaign with real-time tracking**


[Clipping Culture](https://clippingculture.com/) is one of the largest community-powered clipping operations on the market, with a network of 100,000+ active clippers and over 10 billion views generated for clients. They have been featured in Forbes, Variety, and Business Insider, and their client list spans BBNO$, Selena Gomez, Russ, Zedd, HBO Max, Capitol Records, Universal Music Group, Coachella, and Dhar Mann Studios.


For livestreamers, the appeal is speed and scale. Clipping Culture can launch a campaign within one to two days of an intro call, and they manage the full lifecycle: strategy, clipper activation, posting coordination, quality review, and real-time performance reporting.


### How Campaigns Work


Their three-step process is built for momentum:


1. **Strategy call:** You bring your vision; they build the campaign playbook, angle mapping, and rollout structure.
2. **Distribution wave:** Their clipper network floods TikTok, Reels, X, and YouTube Shorts simultaneously with staggered posting windows to sustain algorithmic momentum.
3. **Real-time tracking:** A performance dashboard shows videos created, views generated, and clip-level data so the team can double down on what is working.


**The numbers they cite:**


- 100,000+ active clippers
- 340% engagement lift on optimized campaigns
- Typical launch window of 1 to 2 days after the initial call


### Who It Is Best For


Clipping Culture is a strong fit for streamers who produce consistent long-form content and want a managed, data-driven distribution system rather than a DIY approach. Their campaign model is particularly well-suited to streamers with entertainment-focused content (gaming, variety, IRL) where a high volume of clips can be distributed without requiring tight editorial control over each one.


> **Worth noting:** Their client base skews heavily toward music artists and brands. Streamers are a natural fit, but the agency's primary framing is around entertainment campaigns rather than streamer-specific growth.


## 4. Clouted


**Best for: Streamers, artists, and creators who want a tech-forward virality engine with AI-powered moment detection**


[Clouted](https://clouted.com/) (formerly Clout Kitchen) is backed by a16z Speedrun, Peak XV, Weekend Fund, and several other notable investors, which puts it in a different category from most agencies on this list. It is not just a managed service; it is a platform with its own campaign infrastructure, real-time analytics, and AI-powered content ingestion.


Their headline stat: 200M+ views generated monthly for clients, with a CPM that is one-fifth of traditional paid media. Their client work spans Akon, Zedd, Illenium, G.E.M., and Jessi, all artists with audiences ranging from hundreds of thousands to tens of millions.


### What Makes Clouted Different


Most clipping agencies are human-operated networks. Clouted layers technology on top of that model:


Feature What It Does


AI Moment Detection Scans footage for emotional peaks, narrative beats, and trending formats; assigns performance likelihood scores


Smart Ingestion Accepts livestreams, VODs, raw footage, and music assets; timestamps and structures content automatically


Campaign Builder Set targeting, creative guidelines, and platform preferences; routes campaigns through thousands of trained creators


Real-Time Analytics Track reach, CPM, creator output, and clip-level rankings as campaigns scale


Autonomous Optimization Performance data feeds back into the campaign to improve hit rates without manual intervention


For streamers, the smart ingestion and moment detection features are particularly relevant. Rather than manually flagging timestamps or exporting segments, you can upload a VOD and let the system identify what is worth clipping.


### Who It Is Best For


Clouted is the right fit for streamers who want a technology-driven approach to distribution rather than a purely human-managed one. Their investor backing and platform depth suggest they are building toward a more scalable, self-serve model. If you produce high volumes of stream content and want a system that can keep pace, Clouted is worth a close look.


**Budget signal:** Their intake form starts at $5,000 to $10,000, which positions them above entry-level agencies.


## 5. Clipping Agency


**Best for: Streamers and creators who want a fully managed, community-powered distribution engine with a dedicated podcast and creator offering**


[Clipping Agency](https://clippingagency.co/) runs one of the most well-documented community-powered models in the space. Rather than a small editorial team, they build and manage a network of vetted clippers who distribute your content simultaneously across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. The agency claims 2 billion+ views generated for clients and reports that most creators see a 10x increase in short-form output within the first 30 days.


For streamers specifically, they offer a service that maps well onto the VOD repurposing workflow: long-form content goes in, 10 to 30 clips come out per session, with editing, distribution, and payout management all handled by their team.


### Their Three-Stage Process


1. **System Setup:** Clipping infrastructure configured, including Whop dashboard, automation, and submission rules
2. **Community Onboarding:** Clippers recruited, vetted, and onboarded to earn payouts for distributing your content
3. **Operations and Management:** Quality review, approvals, payouts, and performance tracking handled end-to-end


**What clients report:**


- 10x increase in short-form content output within 30 days
- 1 to 5 million additional monthly views across TikTok and Reels
- 100% managed operations with no internal team required


### Who It Is Best For


Clipping Agency works well for streamers who are already producing consistent long-form content and want to scale distribution without building an in-house editing operation. Their community-driven model is particularly effective for shows with broad audience appeal where many different clippers can independently find compelling moments.


**The honest trade-off:** The network model prioritizes volume over editorial precision. If your stream requires tight brand control or very specific clip formatting, a boutique editorial service may be a better fit than a community distribution network.


## 6. Short Form Media


**Best for: Streamers who are also building a personal brand and want a full-service production team, not just a clipping operation**


[Short Form Media](https://shortformmedia.co/) is not a pure clipping agency, but it belongs on this list because of the overlap between their model and what high-growth streamers actually need. They position themselves as a personal branding agency for executives and founders, but their production system is directly applicable to streamers who want polished, brand-consistent short-form content.


Their core proposition: 4 hours of filming per quarter converts into 90 days of content across all platforms. They report 800M+ organic views for clients and claim the average client has a video go viral within 42 days of starting.


### What They Offer


Short Form Media handles the full stack from planning through posting:


- **Planning:** 60+ content ideas generated per session
- **Production:** Quarterly in-person or remote shoots (their team travels to the client)
- **Editing:** 30 to 90 second clips optimized for retention
- **Posting:** Full cross-platform distribution handled by their team


Their Miami and NYC presence makes them a practical option for streamers in those markets who want in-person production alongside clip editing.


### Who It Is Best For


Short Form Media is the right fit for streamers who are simultaneously building a personal brand beyond their stream. If you are a streamer who also creates educational content, speaks at events, or has a business tied to your online presence, their model integrates those content types naturally.


For streamers who purely want stream VOD clipping without a broader production relationship, this agency may be more infrastructure than you need. But for the streamer who wants to become a recognizable name off-platform as well as on it, SFM is worth a serious look.


## 7. Lumina Clippers


**Best for: Streamers looking for a dedicated clipping and distribution service focused on brand content**


[Lumina Clippers](https://luminaclippers.com/) positions itself as a content clipping and distribution agency for brands. Their public-facing information is limited, which makes a detailed breakdown difficult, but their focus on brand content distribution places them in the same category as the community-powered agencies on this list.


For streamers, Lumina is worth exploring if you are looking for a smaller-scale or more boutique option than the high-volume networks like Clipping Culture or Clipping Agency. The limited public footprint suggests they may operate with a more selective client base and a more hands-on approach.


**Recommendation:** Book a discovery call before committing. Given the limited public information available, understanding their specific workflow for streaming content, their clipper network size, and their platform coverage is essential before making a decision.


## 8. Clip.tech


**Best for: Streamers and creators who want to tap into a curated clipper community for organic short-form distribution**


[Clip.tech](https://www.clip.tech/) describes itself as "the future of organic growth," built around a curated network of digital marketers who distribute short-form content at scale. Their model is straightforward: they deliver short-form media through their clipper network to maximize reach at a fraction of traditional advertising costs.


Like Lumina Clippers, Clip.tech has a minimal public footprint, which limits how much can be assessed from the outside. What is clear is that they operate a community-based distribution model with a Discord-based clipper network, and their primary value proposition is organic reach without paid ad spend.


For streamers on a tighter budget who want to test community-powered clipping before committing to a larger agency, Clip.tech is worth a conversation. Their Discord community also provides a direct line to clippers, which could be useful for streamers who want more visibility into who is handling their content.


**The honest caveat:** Without published case studies, view counts, or named clients, it is difficult to benchmark Clip.tech against the larger players on this list. Treat them as an emerging option worth evaluating rather than a proven at-scale solution.


## 9. Growthcurve


**Best for: Streamers and creators who need a full-stack growth partner, not just a clipping service**


[Growthcurve](https://growthcurve.co/) is not a clipping agency. It is a full-service growth marketing firm that has been operating for over a decade and counts Coinbase, Mastercard, and a range of high-growth startups among its clients. Clipping is one service within a much broader offering that includes paid social, paid search, UGC ads, influencer marketing, ecommerce growth, and creative production.


They are rated 4.9 stars on Clutch and describe themselves as "the first call the best founders, marketing leaders and investors make when they need to scale a company fast."


### What They Offer Relevant to Streamers


Growthcurve's clipping and short-form capabilities sit within their creative production and UGC ads services. For a streamer, the relevant offerings are:


- **Creative Production:** High-performance ad creative for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and more
- **UGC Ads:** Authentic customer-created content to drive engagement and conversions
- **Paid Social Campaigns:** Amplifying content reach through targeted paid distribution
- **Influencer Marketing:** Creator sourcing and campaign management


### Who It Is Best For


Growthcurve is the right fit for streamers who have grown their channel to a point where they need a full growth infrastructure, not just a clipping operation. If you are running a streaming-adjacent business, have sponsorship revenue to invest, or want to treat your stream as a media brand with a paid acquisition strategy, Growthcurve can build that system.


**Important context:** If you are primarily looking for someone to clip and distribute your VODs, Growthcurve is likely more agency than you need. Their model is built for brands with significant marketing budgets. For pure clipping, the community-network agencies earlier in this list are a more direct fit.


## 10. Growthr


**Best for: Streamers who have built a media brand and need enterprise-grade growth infrastructure across paid, organic, and creative**


[Growthr](https://growthr.com/) is a full-stack growth agency, not a clipping-first shop. Their client roster includes Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan Chase, Mastercard, Rockstar Games, OVO (Drake's label), Keinemusik, Slack, and Intel. They have managed $250M+ in ad spend and helped clients achieve $1.5B+ in exits.


Clipping is listed as one of their capabilities under the Growth services menu, described as "long-form content repurposed into short-form for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts." But the context matters: at Growthr, clipping is one tool in a much larger arsenal that includes paid social, paid search, influencer marketing, creative production, product design, web development, and custom AI products.


### Why a Streamer Might Consider Growthr


The case for Growthr is not clipping volume. It is strategic integration. If you are a streamer who has built a real media business with sponsorship revenue, merchandise, or a product tied to your audience, Growthr can run the full growth operation: paid acquisition, creative testing, attribution infrastructure, and short-form distribution all under one roof.


Their embedded model is worth noting. Rather than operating as a traditional agency with weekly check-ins, they integrate directly into your team's workflows and communication channels.


**The honest reality:** For a streamer who just wants their VODs clipped and posted, Growthr is significant overkill. Their model is built for companies with real marketing budgets and growth targets. The streamers who belong at Growthr are the ones who have outgrown "just a streamer" and are running a content business at scale.


> Think of the difference between hiring a clipper and hiring a CMO. Growthr is the latter.

### The Decision Framework


Use these questions to narrow it down fast:


- **Do you want clips published to accounts you own?** Start with Overlap so the handles, followers, posts, data, and eligible platform revenue stay with you.
- **Do you want to pay for delivered views rather than for hours or clips?** Overlap bills a CPM between $0.50 and $2.50 on delivered views, agreed per campaign, up to a ceiling you set, with no production fee.
- **Do you want a burst of third-party network distribution?** Consider Clipping Culture, Clipping Agency, or Clip Central.
- **Do you want AI-assisted moment detection inside a creator network?** Clouted is built for this.
- **Are you building a personal brand beyond your stream?** Short Form Media fits here.
- **Do you need a full growth operation, not just clipping?** Growthcurve or Growthr, depending on your budget and scale.
- **Are you early-stage and want to test before committing?** Clip.tech or a discovery call with Lumina Clippers.


### The #1 Choice for an Owned Streamer Clipping Operation


Traditional agencies make sense when you specifically want access to their third-party page network or a specialist creative team for a defined campaign. But when those accounts belong to the agency, the followers and monetization potential do not become durable assets for your streaming business.


[Overlap](https://overlap.ai/brands/streamers) is the #1 option on this list for the owned model. AI-powered fulfillment keeps production costs down, CPM pricing ties spend to delivered views, and publishing to your accounts means every successful clip can add to an audience, library, and monetization channel you keep.


For streamers who want short-form growth to compound instead of resetting with every agency campaign, Overlap is the better place to start.


## Frequently Asked Questions


### Is Overlap a clipping agency for streamers?


No. Overlap is an AI-fulfilled clipping campaign platform: software-run managed campaigns on accounts you own, covering clip selection, editing, approval workflows, publishing, and reporting. A clipping agency supplies editors, producers, or a creator network under its own terms, and often on accounts it controls.


### What does an Overlap streamer campaign cost?


You set a monthly ceiling and agree a CPM between $0.50 and $2.50. Spend follows the views actually delivered and stops at the ceiling; there are no production fees, no minimum deliverables, and nothing charged for reach that did not land.


### Who owns the clip accounts when the campaign ends?


You do. The handles, the followers, and every clip published to them stay with you, the posts are not taken down when billing stops, and the accounts are never repurposed for another advertiser.


### Do clipping agencies post to the streamer's own accounts?


Sometimes. Most of the agencies in this guide distribute through their own network pages or through clippers' accounts; some also create brand-specific accounts or offer white-label distribution. Confirm ownership, login access, post retention, and handover terms before signing.


### Did Overlap test the agencies in this guide?


No. Each agency entry summarizes that provider's public pages as linked beside it, and any figures are the agency's own statements. This guide does not claim hands-on testing, audited results, or comparable campaign performance across providers.
